summary: Spruce Power Holding Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the expected completion of its previously approved change in domicile from Delaware to Texas, effective on or about October 20, 2026. Stockholders approved the redomiciliation at the reconvened 2026 Annual Meeting on August 25, 2026, with roughly 86% of votes cast in favor; the board had approved it May 1, 2026. The conversion preserves the company's existence, headquarters, business, management, assets and liabilities, and NYSE listing under SPRU, with no trading interruption expected. This is a routine corporate reincorporation, not a special situation.
